# Arkansas Automated

> Arkansas Automated is Brassfield Ventures LLC in Fort Smith. It is not Arkansas Automated Security, LLC of Mayflower. We sell done-for-you AI setups and business automations: missed-call text back from $129/month, after-hours answering from $299/month, AI front desk from $499/month, and scoped custom builds from $2,500. The free missed-call test shows what callers hear before a paid setup. Phone (479) 492-4232.

## Key locations

Every city below has an AI receptionist page at /ai-receptionist/[city] and a business automation page at /locations/[city].

- River Valley: [Fort Smith](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fort-smith) (home base), Van Buren, Russellville
- Northwest Arkansas: [Fayetteville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/fayetteville), Springdale, [Rogers](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/rogers), [Bentonville](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/bentonville), Bella Vista, Siloam Springs
- Central Arkansas: [Little Rock](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/little-rock), North Little Rock, [Conway](https://arkansasautomated.com/ai-receptionist/conway), Jacksonville, Cabot, Benton, Bryant, Hot Springs, Searcy
- Northeast Arkansas and the Delta: Jonesboro, Paragould, Batesville, West Memphis
- South and Southwest Arkansas: Texarkana, El Dorado, Pine Bluff
